authorization: User explicitly requested publication and production deployment of the evaluated conversational guide and source-faithful reviews.
release_blockers: Exact candidate, 21 passed actual-model development cases, rendered/original answer hashes, and evaluated runtime hashes match preserved evidence.
Frontend and agent unit suites, lint, TypeScript/build and isolated database gates pass; reuse hash-matched completed browser campaigns for the exact implementation.
Verify production AWS and Supabase project identities before writes.
Nine additive draft/publication-guard migrations preserve research data, private RLS/browser denial and every active prompt pointer.
Review scoped Agent stack diff: only declared agent code changes, retain deployed dependencies and configuration, no benchmark/AMI/instance changes.
Deploy compatible agent before changing the existing prompt pointer; verify deployed ZIP and evaluated runtime file hashes.
Archive original successful and failed evaluations privately, retrieve them and verify original hashes before guarded publication.
Publish exact v11 through the existing compare-and-swap RPC; preserve earlier failures, prior prompt and publication history.
Release only scoped frontend changes; preserve separately staged PDFs and unrelated work. Runtime dependency audit has no high/critical advisories.
Verify public production routes, sign-in return paths, anonymous write/model denial, capabilities, desktop/mobile themes, existing result exports, active candidate and deployed file hashes.
order: Commit scoped sources to main with unrelated CI skipped
Deploy and verify compatible Agent stack
conditional_checks: Actual Google-authenticated coaching/review and persistence require a legitimate available session; never fabricate one.
Cross-owner authenticated denial requires two legitimate sessions.
Independent, held-out and human answer review remain unavailable.

resources.billing: Retain tokens and observed bytes/times where available. Missing charges, local compute and unallocated costs remain unknown, not zero.

scientific_scope: Software and AI review behavior only; no new research hypothesis is assessed. Development cases reviewed by the AI implementer are neither human nor independent validation.
ci_scope: Scoped source commits use [skip ci] [skip-cd] to prevent unrelated all-stack/AMI jobs and premature frontend builds. No required protected checks are bypassed. Start one explicit Amplify release after publication.
rollback: Preserve old deployed ZIP, prior prompt and publication history. Restore the prior code and prompt via a recorded guarded release if necessary; do not drop schema or delete research evidence.
retained_limits: Custom networking package admission remains disabled. This release does not claim production validation of every networking runner.
